title: Fixed-scale real-SWAP tangent and corrector-status topology diagnostic
purpose: Explain why the preregistered G09 E1 scale-consistency gate failed at C3_LONG_HIGH positive edge before proposing any replacement estimator.
sample_rule: For each state and each d, evaluate h0, h0-d, h0+d, h0-2d and h0+2d from the same immutable accepted origin. Record participant status/q where available and raw corrector diagnostics for every unique head. No adaptive deletion or scale selection.
derived_diagnostics: central slope when h0-d and h0+d are both participant-status 0
second-order backward slope when h0-d and h0-2d are both status 0
second-order forward slope when h0+d and h0+2d are both status 0
least-squares slope over all status-0 samples in the five-point stencil when at least three distinct points are available
raw result/completion/candidate/retry/solver/temporal/mass diagnostics at every unique sample head
diagnostic_questions: Is the C3-positive G09 inconsistency caused by genuine q(H) curvature, by scale-dependent/fragmented corrector admissibility, or by both?
Do participant status-6 points correspond to raw corrector solver/retry failures rather than a smooth one-sided physical domain boundary?
Does the C2-negative control show the same fragmented status topology despite a stable one-sided derivative?
hard_rules: No post-hoc removal of a scale.
Every participant trial is discarded and accepted revision/time/ledger must remain unchanged.
G09A is diagnostic-only: completion does not qualify a replacement tangent estimator.
decision_after_execution: Only after G09A may a replacement estimator (e.g. status-aware local regression) be preregistered.
